finalText: Build's clean. Two bugs the package bump exposed: `src/core/options.js` was reaching for `options.retries` when the new bundler passes `retryCount`, and `src/net/retryPolicy.js` didn't account for `undefined` flags from the new config loader (used to get `false`). Fixed both, and now it exits with zero errors and the 8 deprecation warnings are just noise from the dependencies.
